01

A club for
Drumchapel.

Based at Drumchapel Sports Centre on Drumry Road East — boxing for the local community and beyond.

Drumchapel Boxing Club — Drumchapel ABC — is an amateur boxing club affiliated with Boxing Scotland, based at Drumchapel Sports Centre in the heart of Drumchapel, Glasgow.

Boxing here is about more than the ring. Young people walk in shy, restless or unsure of themselves — and they walk out taller. The sport teaches them to stand their ground, and the room teaches them they belong.

Adults train alongside them: fitness, pad work, footwork and real technique, coached properly and at your pace. Whether you have never thrown a punch or you have boxed before, there is a place for you on the floor.

DisciplineShow up. Work hard. Repeat.
ConfidenceBuilt round by round.
RespectFor coaches, opponents, yourself.
CommunityA club that belongs to Drumchapel.

A Boxing Scotland affiliated club, led by a head coach who knows the Drumchapel game inside out.

Head coach

Gerry Docherty.

Head coach of Drumchapel Boxing Club. Training at Drumchapel is built on the amateur boxing tradition — technique first, always — with every boxer coached as an individual, whatever their age or level.

As a Boxing Scotland affiliated club, Drumchapel ABC trains to the national governing body’s standards — the same pathway that takes young boxers from their first session to championship bouts.
